title: Crash when loading scene with subviewports when the subscene has SDFGI enabled
body:
### Tested versions

4.7 beta4,  4.6.3, 4.6.2, 4.6.1, 4.6, 4.5.2, 4.5.1
(all downloaded from https://godotengine.org/download/archive/).

### System information

Windows 11 (dx12 and vulkan) and MacOs tahoe 26.5 (metal and vulkan)

### Issue description

Crash when opening scene, either through project dock or through scene tabs.
